items: BUILT FOR COMFORT - Ergonomic keyboard designed with a generous palm rest and tilt legs, offers a better typing position to reduce the pressure on your wrist. The wireless mouse provides total comfort with a perfect handshake angle, contoured grips and premium matte finish.

FULL-SIZE KEYBOARD WITH HOLDER - Even when working with this keyboard mouse combo, you'll never miss any messages from your phone, since the built-in cradle can prop up your phone or tablet at a perfect angle to read or watch videos.

ENERGY SAVING & DURABILITY - Wireless mouse and keyboard features with smart sleep mode for saving power. Idle for 15 mins, the keyboard will sleep, idle for 10 mins, the mouse will sleep, press any button or key to wake up. You can go for months without the hassle of changing the batteries. The keyboard needs 2 x AAA battery, the mouse needs 1 x AA battery. (Battery Not Included)

LESS NOISE, MORE FOCUS - Soft membrane keys for making typing quiet and smooth. You can now enjoy quiet and comfortable typing all day long. The wireless mouse feels just as clicky but makes 95% less noise. No more worry about disturbing others.

NO DELAY, ENJOY WIRELESS FREEDOM - Plug and play, only one USB receiver for both keyboard and mouse! Upgraded chips and 2.4GHz wireless technology provide a stable and reliable connection up to 33ft without any latency.

MULTI-FUNCTION & EFFICIENCY - This wireless keyboard mouse combo features 6 commonly used hotkeys that allow you to browse the webpage and access the calculator with one click. 6-button mouse with forward/backward functions will help you navigate the web faster and easier than ever before.
